claim.statement: The 0.146.0 release announces app-server support for connecting remote Code Mode hosts over WebSocket; this is an app-server or remote-host path and is not evidence that an ordinary local CLI terminal session executes remotely.

source.title: OpenAI Codex 0.146.0 release
source.locator: New features: app-server remote Code Mode hosts over WebSocket

values: app-server remote Code Mode host over WebSocket

limitations: The release note identifies support, not an observed remote-host deployment or its transport security.
The app-server path is a companion surface with a different runtime and transport boundary from local CLI terminal execution.
unknowns: Whether app-server is used, the remote host identity, transport authentication, TLS, network reachability, execution placement and tool authority are unknown.

analysis.note: The release distinguishes local CLI delivery from the app-server remote-host companion path.

relationships.note: Remote app-server support must not be transferred to ordinary local CLI terminal behavior.
